segments.text: [cheerful] The sun goes down, the sky turns blue. The stars wake up, and so do you! Who is glowing in the grass? *Five little fireflies*! Blink, blink, blink!
[playfully] Let's count them! *One, two, three, four, five*! Five little lights that dance and fly!
[sing-song] *Five little fireflies*, glowing in the night. One flew up, up, up, to the moon so bright! Blink, blink, blink! Goodnight, little light!
[sing-song] *Four little fireflies*, glowing in the night. One flew up, up, up, to the moon so bright! Blink, blink, blink! Goodnight, little light!
[sing-song] *Three little fireflies*, glowing in the night. One flew up, up, up, to the moon so bright! Blink, blink, blink! Goodnight, little light!
[sing-song] *Two little fireflies*, glowing in the night. One flew up, up, up, to the moon so bright! Blink, blink, blink! Goodnight, little light!
[sing-song] *One little firefly*, glowing in the night. She flew up, up, up, to the moon so bright! Blink, blink, blink! Goodnight, little light!
[amazed] No little fireflies glowing in the grass. But look up high! *Five new stars* are twinkling in the sky! [gentle] Blink, blink, blink. Goodnight, goodnight!
